title: Toast and Filter Popover
prompt: Two flavors, right tool each: (1) a toast notification as popover="manual" (no light dismiss) that carries its own close button (popovertarget + popovertargetaction="hide"); (2) a filter panel as a plain auto popover (light dismiss expected). Distinct ids; no JavaScript.

tests.name: manual toast with explicit close
tests.hint: manual means the platform will never close it for you — the close button is not optional.

tests.name: auto popover for the filter panel
tests.hint: Bare popover (or popover="auto") gets light dismiss — the right flavor for a transient panel.

tests.name: two distinct ids
tests.hint: Each popover is its own element with its own id — the invokers reference them individually.
